title: Candidate
description: An input the pipeline should look for anagrams of. One line of data/candidates.jsonl.

id.description: The input's folded letters, a colon, and the category. Stable under accents, spacing and punctuation, so 'Beyoncé' and 'beyonce' are one candidate.

input.description: The text as a person would write it.

status.description: new: waiting for its next run. enumerated: processed under its last run; pnpm hits:requeue sends it back to new when the settings or the rubric move on. unclassified: the trending feed found it but no category could be assigned. rejected: not worth running (junk, or a person asked).

runs.description: Each queue this candidate went through, with the enumeration settings and the rubric it was processed under, oldest first. A candidate with no runs was processed before they were recorded, under settings s1 and rubric v1.
